evals.name: check-then-confirm
evals.prompt: hey, review season is coming up and I need to pull together my self-review. I'm a senior engineer, most of my work is on github. can you help me show what I've done?
evals.expected_output: A first reply that runs only read-only checks (git, GitHub access, login, clones, emails, shallow clones), reports what it found, then asks the first open question with a recommended answer, and ends with a step/next/undo status line. No harvest, no files written.
assertions: Runs only read-only commands before replying (no harvest queries, no writes)
Reports detected findings (GitHub access, login, emails, clones) rather than asking for them
Asks one question at a time, not a list of questions
Offers a recommended answer the person can accept in a word
Ends with a status line naming the current step, the next step, and how to undo
Later asks for lookback window, purpose/level, and yardstick (leveling guide or role description), with KPIs/OKRs optional
Shows the profile before writing impact-profile.md

evals.name: full-run-git-only
evals.prompt: Write my impact doc. Intake answers, so skip the interview and go: I'm Dave Holmes-Kinsella, GitHub login dhk, commit emails davehk@gmail.com and github@dhk.io. Window 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-01. Repo: dhk/tricorder, full-history local clone (read-only). No gh CLI or GitHub token available, git only. Assess at my current level, Staff Engineer. No leveling guide; role description: 'Staff engineer: sets technical direction for a product area, ships high-leverage systems, raises team standards through docs, research and tooling, and makes others more effective.' OKR: 'Publish 3 public tricorder case studies with explorer links.' Audience: self-review draft, first person.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown impact document following the report template, every rating backed by SHAs/PR numbers/counts, Observed/Inferred labels, review work marked not visible (git only), co-authored commits disclosed, a Tricorder section with privacy caveats, and a methodology appendix with commands.
assertions: Has a scorecard table with Exceeds/Meets/Not visible ratings
Every Exceeds/Meets rating cites a commit SHA, PR number, or count
Marks review work as not visible because only git was available
Discloses Co-Authored-By / AI-assisted commits in the methodology
States there is no team baseline (sole human contributor)
Includes a Tricorder section naming discover --history and a privacy caveat for learn
Lists the commands behind the numbers
Maps evidence to the stated OKR
